title: 第3章 要脸不第4章 扶弟魔
slug: 剑道狂神第4623章一枚令牌
lines: 唐天口中的“回去”
，自然便是落星城唐家！
拥有这具身体所有的记忆，对于落星城有了一个清晰的了解。
目前位于落星城外，有百里远的落星森林边缘。
原因便是被那个被称为“林少”
的胖子林宝全，将原来的“唐天”
，从落星城绑到了这里，就是为了杀掉他！
唐家与秦家十五年前联姻，唐家少爷唐天与秦家大小姐秦月熙定下娃娃亲。
落星城有四大家族，唐家、秦家、林家、叶家势均力敌。
林宝全，林家的三少爷。
一直对秦月熙心生爱慕，对这门婚事耿耿于怀，一直想找机会除掉唐天。
唐天摇了摇头，叹了一口气道：“他们已经形神俱灭，也算是给你报了仇。”
从今以后，唐天将会以“他”
的身份，生活在这个世界！
落星城并没有多么的广阔繁华，至少在唐天看来，只是一座小城，透着一抹沧桑和古朴。
凭着记忆，进了城门之后，唐天一路慢慢悠悠的前往唐家。
站在唐家门口的两名护卫，见到唐天回来，双眼中毫不掩饰的泛起了鄙夷。
对于这个废物少爷，整个唐家上下，谁人不知谁人不晓。
十五岁的年纪，还只是炼脉境中阶，分明就是一个废物！
在这个实力为尊的世界，实力差就是让人看不起的原罪！
两名护卫对唐天这个家主儿子，没有丝毫的敬畏，其中一位身形较为魁梧的护卫，冷笑道：“少爷，现在最好还是别进去。”
对于两名护卫的态度，唐天看在眼里，结合记忆，会这样毫不意外。
原本的唐家少爷，是一个外表柔弱，内心倔强的人。
唐天前世作为人人敬仰的炼丹师，脾气性格较之原本的“唐天”
，自然不同。
“家主正在招待秦家家主和秦家大小姐，少爷现在进去的话，怕是会自取其辱……”
另一个瘦高的护卫斜睨着唐天，嘲讽之意尽显。
或许因为重生的缘故，唐天的魂魄极为强大，面前两名护卫的修为，竟然可以看出来。
焚血境高阶的护卫，就可以如此嚣张跋扈，目中无人了？
两名护卫目光轻蔑，根本就没有将一个废物少爷放在眼里。
正要夸夸其谈，其中那位身形魁梧的护卫，就感觉到脖子一紧。
重生在一个废材身上，唐天本来就很不爽，现在又遇到狗眼看人低的家伙，又怎么能忍？
打通了一百零八条隐脉之后，其本身蕴含的元力，就已经超过了普通同阶修者的数十倍不止。
以唐天此刻的实力来说，对战普通的焚血境高阶修者，根本不是什么问题。
那身形魁梧的护卫还没有反应过来，就已经被唐天拽着脖子，狠狠的砸在了地上。
一声巨响，地面都在震动。
看着面前暴力的唐天，另一位护卫早已经目瞪口呆。
实在是想不明白，炼脉境的废物，完虐焚血境高阶的修者？
唐天将手中的护卫，如同扔一条死狗一般，扔在了地上，淡然道：“出手教训你一下，让你知道什么叫尊卑有序。
护卫，就要有护卫的觉悟。”
“我们……我们可是风少的人，你……你会后悔的……啊！”
content_en:
"Go back" in Tang Tian's mouth
, naturally it is the Tang family of Falling Star City!
With all the memories of this body, I have a clear understanding of Falling Star City.
It is currently located outside Luo Xing City, at the edge of Luo Xing Forest, a hundred miles away.
The reason is that he was called "Master Lin"
The fat man Lin Baoquan changed the original "Tang Tian"
, was kidnapped here from Falling Star City just to kill him!
The Tang family and the Qin family got married fifteen years ago, and Tang Tian, ​​the young master of the Tang family, and Qin Yuexi, the eldest daughter of the Qin family, arranged a baby marriage.
There are four major families in Falling Star City, the Tang family, the Qin family, the Lin family, and the Ye family are evenly matched.
Lin Baoquan, the third young master of the Lin family.
She has always been in love with Qin Yuexi and has always been worried about this marriage. She has always wanted to find an opportunity to get rid of Tang Tian.
Tang Tian shook his head, sighed and said: "They have been completely destroyed physically and mentally. They have avenged you."
From now on, Tang Tian will use "him"
identity, living in this world!
Falling Star City is not that vast and prosperous. At least in Tang Tian's view, it is just a small city with a touch of vicissitudes and simplicity.
Based on his memory, after entering the city gate, Tang Tian walked slowly and leisurely to the Tang family.
The two guards standing at the door of Tang's house had undisguised disdain in their eyes when they saw Tang Tian returning.
Everyone in the Tang family knows about this good-for-nothing young master.
At the age of fifteen, he is still only at the middle level of the Pulse Refining Realm, so he is clearly a waste!
In this world where strength is respected, poor strength is the original sin that makes people look down upon!
The two guards showed no respect for Tang Tian, the son of the family master. One of the guards, who was relatively tall, sneered and said, "Master, it's best not to go in now."
"Oh?"
Regarding the attitude of the two guards, Tang Tian saw it in his eyes and combined with his memory, it was no surprise that they would be like this.
The original young master of the Tang family was a weak man on the outside but stubborn on the inside.
In his previous life, Tang Tian was an alchemist respected by everyone, and his temperament and personality were worse than those of the original "Tang Tian"
, naturally different.
"The head of the family is entertaining the head of the Qin family and the eldest lady of the Qin family. If the young master goes in now, he will probably humiliate himself..."
Another tall and thin guard looked sideways at Tang Tian, his mockery evident.
Perhaps because of his rebirth, Tang Tian's soul was extremely powerful, and the cultivation level of the two guards in front of him could actually be seen.
Can a high-level guard in the Burning Blood Realm be so arrogant and arrogant?
The two guards looked at him contemptuously, not taking the useless young master seriously at all.
Just as he was about to boast, the burly guard among them felt his neck tighten.
Tang Tian was already unhappy with being reborn in a useless person, but now he met someone who looked down on others, how could he endure it?
After opening up one hundred and eight hidden veins, the energy contained in it has been dozens of times more than that of ordinary cultivators of the same level.
With Tang Tian's current strength, fighting against ordinary high-level cultivators of the Burning Blood Realm is not a problem at all.
Before the burly guard could react, Tang Tian had already grabbed him by the neck and slammed him to the ground.
"Boom"
There was a loud noise and the ground shook.
Seeing the violent Tang Tian in front of him, the other guard was already stunned.
I really can’t understand why a waste in the Pulse Refining Realm can completely abuse a high-level cultivator in the Burning Blood Realm?
Tang Tian threw the guard in his hand on the ground like a dead dog, and said calmly: "Let me teach you a lesson, so that you know what it means to be orderly.
To protect, one must have the consciousness of protecting. "
"We...we are Feng Shao's people, you...you will regret it...ah!"
